subject: gk
question: Effective from 1 April 2022 the Government of India has increased the compensation for the immediate family members of the victims of 'hit - and - run' cases from Rs. 25,000 to __________ for death.
solution:
The correct answer is Rs.**__2,00,000.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways has increased the compensation for the immediate family members of the victims of "hit-and-run" cases from** Rs.25,000 to Rs.2,00,000.**
 
• The Ministry has also published rules regarding the creation, operation, and sources of funds for the motor vehicle accident fund.
 
• The motor vehicle accident fund can be used to provide compensation in hit-and-run accident cases.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **The different types of compensation include**__:

 
 
• Salary
 
• Hourly Wages
 
• Sales Commission
 
• Tips
 
• Stock Options
 
• Bonuses
 
• Incentive Pay
 
• Other Variable Pay
 
• Benefits (healthcare, paid leave, etc.)
 
• Non-monetary compensation (recognition, meals, etc.)
